# The progress bar's track stays light in the dark themes

## Context

During the review of neo #21900 (the Task Worker example), the native `<progress>` track rendered near-white on Neo Dark's dark card. It is the brightest element in the frame: the fill follows the theme, the track does not.

## The Problem

In Chromium with `?theme=neo-theme-neo-dark`, `getComputedStyle(progress).colorScheme` is `normal`, and so are the root and the viewport. The browser therefore draws the track of every `Neo.component.Progress` in its light scheme. It shows in Neo Dark, Dark and Cyberpunk. Users today: `examples/component/progress`, the footer of `examples/grid/streaming`, and the Task Worker example of neo #21900.

Measured on the head of neo #21900 (`00e527f1a9`), whose diff touches neither `Progress.css` nor the theme files. Both are the same on `dev` `3766834958`.

## The Architectural Reality

- Every theme declares its scheme. `--neo-color-scheme` is `dark` in `theme-neo-dark`, `theme-dark` and `theme-cyberpunk`, and `light` in `theme-neo-light` and `theme-light`, each in its `Global.css`.
- Design authority: "The platform-level light/dark hint for THIS theme, declared rather than derived from the theme's name" (`resources/css/theme-neo-dark/Global.css`, the comment on `--neo-color-scheme`).
- One component already applies it to its native control: `resources/css/src/form/field/Select.css` sets `color-scheme: var(--neo-color-scheme)` on the field and on its picker. `resources/css/src/component/Progress.css` sets only the label color.

## The Fix

In `resources/css/src/component/Progress.css`, give the `progress` element `color-scheme: var(--neo-color-scheme)`, as `Select.css` does. Every theme defines the token, so no fallback is needed.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Under a dark theme, the computed `color-scheme` of a Progress's `<progress>` is `dark`. Under a light theme it is `light`. Both come from the scheme the theme declares in `--neo-color-scheme`.
- [ ] A component-tier spec asserts both: red on `dev`, green at the head.
- [ ] Before and after frames of `examples/component/progress` in a dark theme on the pull request.

The ACs were corrected when the pull request opened, on 22 Nov. The first draft named Neo Dark through `?theme=` on the progress example, but that example ignores `?theme=` and offers the engine's Light and Dark through its own Theme Dark button. The component fixture loads Light, Dark and Neo Light. Dark declares the same `dark` as Neo Dark.

## Out of Scope

A `color-scheme` on the viewport root. It would switch every native control and scrollbar at once, while grid and list already set their scrollbars' scheme per component.
